Account.title: Managed Account
Account.description: Admin-managed user account linking workspace permissions, favorites, theme preferences, and Lobby Chat identity/moderation.

username.description: Display username assigned by the administrator.

usernameLower.description: Lowercase canonical username matching the document ID.

passwordSalt.description: Hex salt used for PBKDF2-SHA256 client-side verification.

encryptedPassword.description: Encrypted copy of the account password so administrators can view or recover user passwords.

isActive.description: Whether the account can currently sign in.

isAdmin.description: Whether the account has administrator privileges to manage accounts and workspace settings.

allowGlobalOverride.description: Whether this account can access its enabled workspaces even when those workspaces are turned off globally.

allowAiOverride.description: Custom override granting this account access to AI Chat even when AI Chat is turned off globally.

aiAccess.description: Access to Gemini AI Chat Tutor.

decoysAccess.description: Access to extra tab decoys and auto-randomizer.

chatMuted.description: Whether the account is muted in Lobby Chat.

chatBanned.description: Whether the account is banned from Lobby Chat.

roleBadge.description: Optional Lobby Chat custom role badge label.

favorites.description: List of bookmarked game IDs (up to 500).

recentlyPlayed.description: List of recently played game IDs (up to 30).

preferredTheme.description: Preferred accent color theme or null.

preferredMode.description: Preferred light or dark UI mode or null.

adminNotes.description: Optional administrator notes attached to this user account.

defaultGirlsTheme.description: Whether the administrator assigned the Girls theme by default to this account.

requirePasswordOnUrl.description: Legacy field for direct /username URL password requirement.

allowPasswordlessUrl.description: Whether direct /username URL sign-in without a password has been manually enabled (false by default; /usernamepassword is the default).

totalTimeMs.description: Cumulative active milliseconds spent by this account across sessions.

todayTimeMs.description: Active milliseconds spent today by this account.

todayDateKey.description: YYYY-MM-DD local date key corresponding to todayTimeMs.

sessionCount.description: Total number of authenticated sessions recorded for this account.

currentActivity.description: Current live activity label for online presence (or empty string when offline).

lastActivityAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last tracked activity or null.

activityTimeMs.description: Map of cumulative active milliseconds spent per activity category (games, movies, moremovies, moremoremovies, youtube, lobbychat, ai, catalog).

accountSettings.description: Cross-device synchronized UI, layout, chat theme, decoy, and privacy preferences.

lastLoginAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last sign-in or null.

isOnline.description: Whether the user currently has an active online session.

lastSeenAt.description: Epoch millisecond heartbeat timestamp of last observed activity or null.

WorkspaceConfig.title: Global Workspace Configuration
WorkspaceConfig.description: Site-wide lockdown state, shared passcode policy, and global workspace feature flags.

lockdownMessage.description: Banner message displayed on the lock screen during lockdown.

allowAccountOverrides.description: Whether specific accounts with allowGlobalOverride can access workspaces that are turned off globally.

allowAiOverrides.description: Whether specific accounts with allowAiOverride can access AI Chat even when AI Chat is turned off globally.

girlsThemePolicy.description: Admin-chosen enforcement policy for accounts with defaultGirlsTheme enabled.

girlsThemeSyncChat.description: Whether assigned Girls theme policy also applies to Lobby Chat theme.

moreMoviesAccess.description: Global toggle for More Movies workspace.

moreMoreMoviesAccess.description: Global toggle for MoreMore Movies workspace.

broadcastId.description: Unique identifier of the current global admin broadcast announcement.

broadcastMessage.description: Site-wide announcement text sent by an administrator.

broadcastSender.description: Display name of the administrator who sent the broadcast.

broadcastAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of when the broadcast was sent or null.

updatedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last update.

ChatChannel.title: Lobby Chat Channel
ChatChannel.description: Custom or temporary Lobby Chat channel metadata.

isPasswordProtected.description: Whether entering the channel requires a password.

createdAt.description: Epoch millisecond creation timestamp for 1-hour room TTL.

ChatMessage.title: Lobby Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Encrypted or plaintext Lobby Chat message inside a channel.

accountId.description: Linked account lowercase username or null.

isRegistered.description: Whether the sender posted from a linked account.

isAdmin.description: Whether the sender has administrator privileges.

imageUrl.description: Encrypted image payload or image URL.

isEncrypted.description: Whether text/imageUrl uses AES-GCM v1 payload encryption.

editedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last edit or null.

TypingStatus.title: Lobby Chat Live Typing Presence
TypingStatus.description: Ephemeral live typing indicator state for a participant in a channel or direct message thread.

channelId.description: Parent channel or direct message document ID.

actorId.description: Canonical participant identifier matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name shown in typing indicator.

accountId.description: Linked account lowercase username or null.

isRegistered.description: Whether the typer is signed into a managed account.

isTyping.description: Whether the participant is currently typing.

updatedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last typing update.

expiresAt.description: Epoch millisecond expiration timestamp after which typing status auto-expires.

ReadReceipt.title: Lobby Chat Read Receipt
ReadReceipt.description: Per-participant read watermark for channels and direct message threads.

channelId.description: Parent channel or direct message document ID.

actorId.description: Canonical participant identifier matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name shown in read receipts.

accountId.description: Linked account lowercase username or null.

isRegistered.description: Whether the reader is signed into a managed account.

lastReadAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the newest message read by this participant.

lastReadMessageId.description: Document ID of the newest message read or null.

updatedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of when the receipt was recorded.

DirectMessageThread.title: Direct Message Thread
DirectMessageThread.description: One-to-one direct message conversation metadata between two online/registered users.

participants.description: Sorted two-element array of participant lowercase account IDs.

lastSenderId.description: Lowercase account ID of the most recent sender.

lastSenderName.description: Display name of the most recent sender.

lastMessageText.description: Encrypted preview of the most recent DM.

lastMessageAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the most recent DM.

SignInLink.title: Custom Instant Sign-In Link
SignInLink.description: User-created custom shortcut link that instantly authenticates into their managed account.

codeLower.description: Canonical lowercase custom link code matching the document ID.

accountVerifier.description: Matches the owner account passwordHash at creation so password resets automatically invalidate old links.

label.description: User-facing bookmark label for the link.

defaultView.description: Starting workspace or catalog filter after instant sign-in.

openInAboutBlank.description: Whether launching this link prefers opening in an about:blank cloaked tab.

requirePassword.description: Whether this custom link requires adding the account password at the end of the URL to sign in.

isActive.description: Whether the custom sign-in link is currently active.

useCount.description: Total number of times this link has signed the user in.

lastUsedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of last sign-in via this link or null.

/siteAccounts/{accountId}.description: Stores admin-managed user accounts keyed by lowercase username.

/signInLinks/{linkId}.description: Stores user-created custom instant sign-in links keyed by lowercase link code.

/channels/{channelId}.description: Lobby Chat rooms and temporary channels.

/channels/{channelId}/messages/{messageI.description: Messages posted inside each Lobby Chat channel.

/channels/{channelId}/typing/{actorId}.description: Live typing presence docs per actor inside each Lobby Chat channel.

/channels/{channelId}/readReceipts/{acto.description: Read receipt watermarks per actor inside each Lobby Chat channel.

/directMessages/{dmId}.description: Direct message thread metadata keyed deterministically by sorted participant IDs.

/directMessages/{dmId}/messages/{message.description: Encrypted messages inside a direct message conversation.

/directMessages/{dmId}/typing/{actorId}.description: Live typing presence docs per participant inside a direct message thread.

/directMessages/{dmId}/readReceipts/{act.description: Read receipt watermarks per participant inside a direct message thread.
